rules.name: CVE-2026-33824 — Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-33824: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.. Product: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where (Message contains "CVE-2026-33824" or Message contains "INTERNET KEY EXCHANGE (IKE) SERVICE EXTENSIONS") | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where (Message contains "CVE-2026-68820" or Message contains "WINDOWS ANCILLARY FUNCTION DRIVER FOR WINSOCK") | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
